tasks.title: Essay: Recycling services priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: In your English class you have been discussing how to improve recycling services in your town. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes
listItems: providing clearer information about what can be recycled

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

tasks.title: Review: Recycling centre visit
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted!
paragraphs: Have you visited the new recycling centre in your area? We want to hear about your experience.
Write a review of the recycling centre for our town website.
Describe what facilities are available, say how easy it was to use the service, and explain whether you would recommend it to other residents.
The best reviews will be published on the website.

tasks.title: Article: Encouraging recycling at home
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our town is launching a campaign to encourage more people to recycle at home.

Write an article for the campaign website suggesting one practical way to make recycling easier for families, explaining why it would work, and describing what the result might look like for the community.
We will publish the best articles on our website.

tasks.title: Email: Coordinating a recycling event
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: Recycling event – your help needed
paragraphs: As you know, we are organising a community recycling event next month. I need your help to decide on a few things.
First, should we focus on collecting electronic waste or on teaching people how to compost at home? Which do you think is more important and why?
Also, we need to choose a date. Would you prefer a Saturday morning or a weekday evening?
Finally, can you suggest one way to attract more people to the event?

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Elena. You should explain your preference for the focus of the event, suggest a date and give a reason, and propose a way to attract participants.
